_comment: Phenom People career sites read by sources/phenom.mjs. One entry per tenant. `countries` is the server-side country facet filter (jobs outside it are dropped unless they match the hunt location). Find lang/country/site/pageId by opening <base>/<site>/search-results in a browser and reading the POST /widgets request body in DevTools. Set enabled:false to skip a site.

sites._verified: 2026-09-12: POST /widgets refineSearch returns 10 AU jobs; job pages embed phApp.ddo; /api/apply/v2/jobs answers 'Tenant not identified' (unusable)
